thread:
sam: Deploy blocked: pipeline #3289 failed on 'unpack-wheels' step. deploybot auto-paused the release.

deploy-bot: Promotion paused for commit def456ghi due to step 'unpack-wheels' exit code 1 on runner ci-build-12. Error: wheel extraction failed: "ZipFileBadCRC" for package redwood_core-1.4.8-py3-none-any.whl. Auto-retries used (2/2).

ravi: hmm, I saw intermittent FUSE timeout errors on builders this morning. Could be cached layer corruption on the build node. Any job logs?

sam: paste from job:
```
Unpacking wheels...
Processing redwood_core-1.4.8-py3-none-any.whl
ERROR: ZipFileBadCRC: file CRC mismatch for redwood_core/__init__.py
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.9/site-packages/pip/_internal/commands/install.py", line 286, in run
    ...
```
sam: wheel present in s3 but checksum matches upstream artifact. Suspect runner cache mount corruption (FUSE/overlay).

anya: if it's mount-level corruption, retrying on a different runner might succeed. But change window is tight and we can't risk a bad canary. Recommend pin to v1.4.7 for now and run infra investigation.

ravi: agree. Quick mitigation: 1) mark release pinned to v1.4.7 (manual override), 2) enqueue rebuild of the wheel on a fresh clean builder (no cache), 3) open infra ticket for fuse/overlay health.

sam: commands I'd run:
```
# pin release
deploybot pin promote --release v1.4.7 --by sam --reason "unpack-wheels failures on ci-build-12"
# trigger clean rebuild
buildkite-agent pipeline upload .buildkite/rebuild-clean.yml --env REBUILD_TARGET=3289
```

ops-bot: Incident created: INFRA-2314 "Builder FUSE CRC errors" assigned to infra-oncall. Priority P2. Link: https://tracker.redwood.internal/INFRA-2314

deploy-bot: Manual pin request received by sam. Release pinned to v1.4.7. Promotion canceled for commit def456ghi.

anya: I'll update release notes: "Promotion paused due to wheel extraction errors on CI; release pinned to v1.4.7 pending rebuild and infra investigation." Also notifying QA.

ravi: spinning up clean builder and starting rebuild now. Will post logs.

(18m later)
ravi: clean rebuild finished; wheels uploaded to canonical bucket with verified sha256. Triggered a smoke pipeline on staging (3289-clean).

deploy-bot: Smoke pipeline 3289-clean passed smoke checks. Canaries not auto-promoted due to pin. Manual decision required to unpin and promote.

sam: decision: keep pinned for now until infra confirms root cause. We'll schedule a quick out-of-band promote tomorrow morning if clean builders are validated. For the immediate change window we keep v1.4.7.

anya: added note to release ticket and flagged for morning rollout. Closing thread for this window.
